title: New Moon in Gemini
tldr: A seed point for language, curiosity, learning, conversation, and the courage to name what is true now.
theme: Gemini is a mutable air sign ruled traditionally by Mercury. This New Moon begins work around language, curiosity, learning, conversation, and the courage to name what is true now.
shadow: mental loops that prevent commitment, asking endless questions to avoid choosing
integration: turning scattered information into a message that can move

twoWeekArc.teaching: A small message now can reveal a bigger truth when the opposite-sign Full Moon arrives.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Gemini; watch what the Sagittarius Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Mercury kamea, yellow or white candle, agate or clear quartz, feather, water, and a writing tool.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Gemini. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through language, curiosity, learning, conversation, and the courage to name what is true now, without repeating the shadow of mental loops that prevent commitment, asking endless questions to avoid choosing?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Gemini intention take form?
